Good for whoever's holding it — and worth knowing before you buy, because "Lucky 7 Tripler" now has three top prizes left of the four it launched with. When the top of the board changes, the whole game changes with it. The full tier-by-tier count is in the table below — every prize, counted.
2770.headline: One less $1 million out there

2771.body: Some games are best understood one row of the table at a time. On "Lucky 7 Multiplier" right now, the most common win still waiting is $50 — 478,929 of them on the board — plus ten prizes of $50,000 sitting just under the top end. The full count, top to bottom, is right below. The full tier-by-tier count is in the table below — every prize, counted.
2771.headline: Down in the prize table

2772.body: Brand new to the Texas lineup: "Electric 10s" at $2 with six top prizes of $30,000 on the board. Day one is the only day a scratcher's printed odds tell the whole story — nothing's been won, nothing's been picked over. From tomorrow on, this page is where you watch that change. Same time tomorrow — the board will have moved a little, and this page will move with it.
2772.headline: Day one on the shelf

2773.body: Fresh off the truck: "Sugar Skull Cash", a $5 game from the Texas Lottery with four top prizes of $100,000 on the board. Nothing big has been won yet — almost nobody's played it yet. The moment that changes, the numbers on this page will show it. Same time tomorrow — the board will have moved a little, and this page will move with it.
2773.headline: Factory-fresh and untouched
